summary: There's a part of you that knows a strong will and deep reserves of energy and a serious streak and a quiet fear of not being enough are fused in you — you can't run one without the other. At your best, you go after what you want and don't back down and you build things that last and carry real weight. At the edge, your temper gets ahead of you, or you sit on it until it leaks out sideways.
body: There's a part of you that knows a strong will and deep reserves of energy and a serious streak and a quiet fear of not being enough are fused in you — you can't run one without the other. At your best, you go after what you want and don't back down and you build things that last and carry real weight. At the edge, your temper gets ahead of you, or you sit on it until it leaks out sideways. Endurance and discipline; the friction is the constant start-stop of push against restraint. Desire may come with pressure here. Wanting something can feel tied to effort, restraint, or the need to prove you can handle it.

shadow: The trap: your temper gets ahead of you, or you sit on it until it leaks out sideways — or you hold back, harden, or wait for a permission that never comes.
